# appraisal-cycle.complete

Mark a cycle completed once every appraisal in it is submitted.

**Who may call:** the owner of its appraisalCycle.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 300ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| appraisalCycle | appraisal-cycle.id |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| appraisalCycle | appraisal-cycle.id |

## Move

`complete`: from inProgress to completed, emitting AppraisalCycleCompleted.

## Steps

- `appraisal-cycle.complete.load` (database)
- `appraisal-cycle.complete.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| AppraisalsNotSubmitted | 47 | CY-007 | declared in errors.ts, carrying drafts |
| CycleNameTaken | 48 | CY-008 | another appraisal cycle holds this company and cycle name; by the rule appraisal-cycle.oneNamePerCompany, carrying cycleName |
| AppraisalCycleNotNotStarted | 40 | CY-900 | the appraisal-cycle is in a state complete can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its appraisalCycle.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### appraise a year

Starts from the world `a second feedback criteria`.

- **Cy's is still a draft, so FY 2027 can't be completed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the last call's appraisalCycle, and is refused with AppraisalsNotSubmitted, CY-007.
- **and completes FY 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the last call's appraisalCycle, and is answered.

### give performance feedback

Starts from the world `a manual cycle draft`.

- **and completes H1 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's manualCycle, and gets back the world's manualCycle.

### rate an appraisal

Starts from the world `a manual cycle draft`.

- **and completes H1 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's manualCycle, and gets back the world's manualCycle.

### run an appraisal cycle

Starts from the world `a three-person cycle`.

- **Ada can't complete it before it starts.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with AppraisalCycleNotNotStarted, CY-900, carrying state `notStarted`.
- **it can't complete while both appraisals are drafts.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with AppraisalsNotSubmitted, CY-007, carrying drafts `2`.
- **Bo can't complete it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Olga.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **it still can't complete while Cy's is a draft.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with AppraisalsNotSubmitted, CY-007, carrying drafts `1`.
- **Ada completes the cycle.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and gets back the world's appraisalCycle.
- **it can't complete twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with AppraisalCycleNotNotStarted, CY-900, carrying state `completed`.

### set and track goals

Starts from the world `a started manual cycle`.

- **and completes H2 2026.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and gets back the world's appraisalCycle.

## How to call

```sh
capxul appraisal-cycle complete --appraisalCycle <appraisalCycle>
```

HTTP: `POST /appraisal-cycle/complete` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.appraisal-cycle.complete(payload)`.

# appraisal-cycle.create

Set up an appraisal cycle: its days, how its KRAs are scored, and who is appraised by which template.

**Who may call:** the owner of its company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 300ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| company | appraisal-cycle.company |
| cycleName | appraisal-cycle.cycleName |
| startDate | appraisal-cycle.startDate |
| endDate | appraisal-cycle.endDate |
| kraEvaluationMethod | appraisal-cycle.kraEvaluationMethod |
| appraisees | appraisal-cycle.appraisees |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| appraisalCycle | appraisal-cycle.id |

## Move

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to notStarted, emitting AppraisalCycleCreated.

## Steps

- `appraisal-cycle.create.load` (database)
- `appraisal-cycle.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| CycleEndsBeforeStart | 41 | CY-001 | declared in errors.ts, carrying startDate |
| AppraiseeNotInCompany | 42 | CY-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| AppraiseeHasLeft | 43 | CY-003 | declared in errors.ts |
| AppraiseeTemplateNotInCompany | 44 | CY-004 | declared in errors.ts |
| AppraiseeListedTwice | 45 | CY-005 | declared in errors.ts |
| CycleNameTaken | 48 | CY-008 | another appraisal cycle holds this company and cycle name; by the rule appraisal-cycle.oneNamePerCompany, carrying cycleName |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### appraise a year

Starts from the world `a second feedback criteria`.

- **and FY 2027, scored from goals, appraising Olga and Cy by it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `FY 2027`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-12-31`, kraEvaluationMethod `Automated Based on Goal Progress`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the last call's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's secondEmployee, appraisalTemplate: the last call's appraisalTemplate }], and gets back an answer matching `^apc_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### give performance feedback

Starts from the world `a manual cycle draft`.

- **Ada sets up Q3 2027, rated by hand, and doesn't start it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Q3 2027`, startDate `2027-07-01`, endDate `2027-09-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and gets back an answer matching `^apc_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### run an appraisal cycle

Starts from the world `a three-person cycle`.

- **Bo can't set up a cycle in Acme Trading.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Bo's`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-06-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's secondEmployee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Olga.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Olga's`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-06-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's secondEmployee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **a cycle ending the day before it starts is refused, carrying the start, though Bo is listed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Backwards`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2026-12-31`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's outsider, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with CycleEndsBeforeStart, CY-001, carrying startDate `2027-01-01`.
- **and one ending a month before it starts.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Backwards`, startDate `2027-03-15`, endDate `2027-02-15`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with CycleEndsBeforeStart, CY-001, carrying startDate `2027-03-15`.
- **an appraisee of Acme Logistics is refused, listed last, judged before a repeat.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Outsider`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-06-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's outsider, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with AppraiseeNotInCompany, CY-002.
- **an employee listed twice is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Twice`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-06-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's secondEmployee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with AppraiseeListedTwice, CY-005.
- **a one-day cycle with no appraisees may be set up.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Empty`, startDate `2027-02-01`, endDate `2027-02-01`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [], and gets back an answer matching `^apc_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a cycle's name is taken in Acme Trading.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `H2 2026`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-06-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with CycleNameTaken, CY-008, carrying cycleName `H2 2026`.
- **Acme Logistics may use it for Bo.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, cycleName `H2 2026`, startDate `2026-07-01`, endDate `2026-12-31`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [], and gets back an answer matching `^apc_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a new cycle listing her is refused, judged before a repeat.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Leaver`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-06-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's newHire, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with AppraiseeHasLeft, CY-003.
- **Bo of Acme Logistics is judged before Dee's leaving.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Leaver`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-06-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's newHire, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's outsider, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with AppraiseeNotInCompany, CY-002.
- **Dee's leaving is judged before Cy listed by Acme Logistics' template.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Leaver`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-06-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's secondEmployee, appraisalTemplate: the last call's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's newHire, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with AppraiseeHasLeft, CY-003.
- **a cycle by that template in Acme Trading is refused, listed last, judged before a repeat.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, cycleName `Borrowed`, startDate `2027-01-01`, endDate `2027-06-30`, kraEvaluationMethod `Manual Rating`, appraisees [{ employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's employee, appraisalTemplate: the world's appraisalTemplate }, { employee: the world's secondEmployee, appraisalTemplate: the last call's appraisalTemplate }], and is refused with AppraiseeTemplateNotInCompany, CY-004.

## How to call

```sh
capxul appraisal-cycle create --company <company> --cycleName <cycleName> --startDate <startDate> --endDate <endDate> --kraEvaluationMethod <kraEvaluationMethod> --appraisees <appraisees>
```

HTTP: `POST /appraisal-cycle/create` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.appraisal-cycle.create(payload)`.

| refusal | exit | code | when |

| TemplateWithoutKras | 41 | TP-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| TemplateKraNotInCompany | 42 | TP-002 | declared in errors.ts |

## Worked examples

### appraise a year

Starts from the world `a second feedback criteria`.

- **Ada makes the Platform template: Quality 60 and Development 40, rated on Problem Solving and Excellence, 50 each.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Platform team`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `60`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `40`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### run an appraisal cycle

Starts from the world `a three-person cycle`.

- **Ada makes a template in Acme Logistics.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, title `Drivers`, kras [{ kra: the world's outsideKra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### set up appraisal templates

Starts from the world `an outside criteria`.

- **Ada makes a template of two KRAs and two criteria.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Engineers`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `30`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `30`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Bo can't make one in Acme Trading.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Bo's`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **a template with no criteria and weightages in hundredths is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Thirds`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `3333`, scale: 2 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `6667`, scale: 2 } }], criteria [], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **one KRA may carry the whole hundred, and criteria in tenths.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Quality only`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `101`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `899`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **KRAs a hundredth short of 100 are refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Short`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `30`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `6999`, scale: 2 } }], criteria [], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **and so are KRAs a hundredth over.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Over`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `3001`, scale: 2 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **and one KRA of 50 alone.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Half`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **criteria a hundredth short of 100 are refused, though the KRAs total 100.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Short criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `2999`, scale: 2 } }], and is refused with CriteriaWeightageNotHundred, TP-007.
- **and criteria over 100.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Over criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `40`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with CriteriaWeightageNotHundred, TP-007.
- **when both totals are off, the KRAs' is judged first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Both off`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `30`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `60`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `40`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **a line of weightage 0 is refused, though the total is 100.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Zero line`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `0`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateWeightageOutOfRange, TP-005.
- **and so are a line over 100 and a negative one that make 100 between them.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Lopsided`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `150`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `-50`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateWeightageOutOfRange, TP-005.
- **and a criteria of weightage 0, before the criteria's total.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Zero criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `0`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `90`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateWeightageOutOfRange, TP-005.
- **a template with no KRA is refused, even with criteria from another company.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Empty`, kras [], criteria [{ criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateWithoutKras, TP-001.
- **a KRA of Acme Logistics is refused, judged before a criteria of Acme Logistics.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Mixed`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's outsideKra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateKraNotInCompany, TP-002.
- **a criteria of Acme Logistics is refused, judged before a repeated KRA.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Mixed criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateCriteriaNotInCompany, TP-003.
- **a KRA listed twice is refused, judged before a line of weightage 0.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Twice`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `0`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateLineRepeated, TP-004.
- **and so is a criteria listed twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Twice criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateLineRepeated, TP-004.
- **a title taken in Acme Trading is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Engineers`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateTitleTaken, TP-008, carrying title `Engineers`.
- **a taken title is judged after the weightages.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Engineers`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `99`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **Acme Logistics may use the title for its own KRA and criteria.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, title `Engineers`, kras [{ kra: the world's outsideKra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **but not with Acme Trading's KRA.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, title `Borrowed`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateKraNotInCompany, TP-002.


- **her ratings read back on their criteria, and Ada's scores stand.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends id the world's manualAppraisal, and gets back [[[the world's kra, `30`, `5`, `1.5`], [the world's otherKra, `70`, `3`, `2.1`]], [[the world's criteria, `70`, `0.8`], [the world's otherCriteria, `30`, `0.7`]], `3.6`, `3.85`, `0`, `2.48`, `draft`].
- **Cy's appraisal is untouched by Olga's.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends id the world's secondManualAppraisal, and gets back [[[the world's kra, `30`, `0`, `0`], [the world's otherKra, `70`, `0`, `0`]], [[the world's criteria, `70`, `0`], [the world's otherCriteria, `30`, `0`]], `0`, `0`, `0`, `0`, `draft`].

### set and track goals

# appraisal.rate

Score each KRA of an appraisal by hand, from 0 to 5.

**Who may call:** the owner of its appraisal.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 200ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| appraisal | appraisal.id |
| scores | GivenScores |

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| appraisal | appraisal.id |  |
| totalScore | appraisal.totalScore | The KRAs' score out of 5 (HRMS's `total_score`). |
| finalScore | appraisal.finalScore | The average of the three scores above (HRMS's `final_score`). |

## Move

`rate`: from draft to draft, emitting AppraisalRated.

## Steps

- `appraisal.rate.load` (database)
- `appraisal.rate.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| NotRatedManually | 46 | AP-006 | declared in errors.ts |
| ScoresDontMatchKras | 47 | AP-007 | declared in errors.ts |
| KraScoreOutOfRange | 48 | AP-008 | declared in errors.ts |
| AppraisalAlreadyExists | 51 | AP-005 | another appraisal holds this employee and appraisal cycle; by the rule appraisal.oneAppraisalPerCycle |
| AppraisalNotDraft | 40 | AP-900 | the appraisal is in a state rate can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its appraisal.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### rate an appraisal

Starts from the world `a manual cycle draft`.

- **Olga can't rate her own KRAs.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `3`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Bo.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `3`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **an appraisal scored from goals isn't rated by hand, even with a score out of range.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `6`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `3`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with NotRatedManually, AP-006.
- **scores missing a KRA are refused, even out of range.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `6`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with ScoresDontMatchKras, AP-007.
- **and so are scores naming a KRA twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `3`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with ScoresDontMatchKras, AP-007.
- **and a KRA the appraisal doesn't have.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's outsideKra, score: { value: `3`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with ScoresDontMatchKras, AP-007.
- **and a score for each KRA with one more.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `3`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's outsideKra, score: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with ScoresDontMatchKras, AP-007.
- **a score over 5 is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `501`, scale: 2 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `3`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with KraScoreOutOfRange, AP-008.
- **and one below 0.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `-1`, scale: 2 } }], and is refused with KraScoreOutOfRange, AP-008.
- **Ada scores Quality 5 and Development 3: a total of 3.6.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `3`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back [the world's manualAppraisal, `3.6`, `1.2`].
- **scores given in the other order land on their own KRAs.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `0`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back [`1.5`, `0.5`].
- **a rating replaces the one before: 4.25 earns 1.275, rounded up to 1.28, and 3.15 earns 2.205, rounded up to 2.21.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `425`, scale: 2 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `315`, scale: 2 } }], and gets back [`3.49`, `1.16`].
- **5 and 3 again.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `3`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back `3.6`.
- **nor rated.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with AppraisalNotDraft, AP-900, carrying state `submitted`.
- **and Ada may rate it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's secondManualAppraisal, scores [{ kra: the world's kra, score: { value: `0`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, score: { value: `5`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back [`3.5`, `2.83`].

- **approved, it marks the Friday and Sunday and changes the half-day Saturday.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`2`, `1`].

# bank-account.open

Open a bank account for a company whose KYB Bridge approved: answers where to send deposits.

**Who may call:** the owner of its business.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 800ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| business | bank-account.business | The company's approved KYB the account is opened on. |
| accountName | bank-account.accountName | What the company calls the account (ERPNext's `account_name`). |
| currency | bank-account.currency | The currency it takes deposits in. |

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| account | bank-account.id |  |
| bankName | bank-account.bankName | The bank that holds it, as Bridge names it. |
| accountNumber | bank-account.accountNumber | Its account number, or IBAN, as Bridge gives it. |
| routingNumber | bank-account.routingNumber | Its routing number, or BIC, as Bridge gives it. |

## Move

`open`: from nothing (it creates) to open, emitting BankAccountOpened.

## Steps

- `bank-account.open.load` (database)
- `bank-account.open.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| KybNotApproved | 41 | BA-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| BankAccountNameTaken | 42 | BA-002 | another open bank account holds this company and account name; by the rule bank-account.oneNamePerCompany, carrying accountName |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its business.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account closes

Starts from the world `two bank accounts`.

- **a closed account frees its name for a new one.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `USD`, and gets back an answer matching `^bac_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### bridge: kyb is decided by bridge

Starts from the world `two kybs started`.

- **nor open a bank account before Bridge approves it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `USD`, and is refused with KybNotApproved, BA-001.
- **and opens no bank account.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends business the world's boBusiness, accountName `Main`, currency `EUR`, and is refused with KybNotApproved, BA-001.

### bridge: open a bank account

Starts from the world `kyb approved`.

- **Bo can't open an account on Ada's company.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `USD`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada opens a US dollar account and gets where to send deposits.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `USD`, with the request key `acme-operating`, and gets back an answer matching `^bac_[0-9a-z]+$` and gets back an answer matching `\S` and gets back an answer matching `^\d{4,17}$` and gets back an answer matching `^\d{9}$`.
- **the company has one open account by a name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `EUR`, and is refused with BankAccountNameTaken, BA-002, carrying accountName `Operating`.
- **she opens a euro account under another name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Payroll`, currency `EUR`, and gets back an answer matching `^bac_[0-9a-z]+$` and gets back an answer matching `\S` and gets back an answer matching `^[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{10,30}$` and gets back an answer matching `^[A-Z]{6}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul bank-account open --business <business> --accountName <accountName> --currency <currency>
```

**Who may call:** the self of its reviewer.

**Budget:** p95 200ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |

| appraisal | employee-performance-feedback.appraisal |  |
| reviewer | employee-performance-feedback.reviewer | The employee who gives it. |

## Answer

| field | value | description |

- `employee-performance-feedback.create.load` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| FeedbackCycleCompleted | 41 | PF-007 | declared in errors.ts |
| FeedbackForOneself | 42 | PF-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| ReviewerNotInCompany | 43 | PF-003 | declared in errors.ts |
| ReviewerHasLeft | 44 | PF-004 | declared in errors.ts |
| FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria | 45 | PF-005 | declared in errors.ts |
| FeedbackRatingOutOfRange | 46 | PF-006 | declared in errors.ts |
| AppraisalNotFound | 4 | AP-901 | nothing has the id in appraisal; the handler never runs; carries `id` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the self of its reviewer; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### appraise a year

Starts from the world `a second feedback criteria`.

- **Cy gives feedback on Olga's appraisal, 0.9 and 0.6: a total of 3.75.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the last call's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Ship v2 landed well.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `9`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `6`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back `3.75`.

### give performance feedback

Starts from the world `a manual cycle draft`.

- **Ada can't give feedback in Cy's name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Dee.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Olga can't give feedback on her own appraisal, judged before ratings that don't match.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's employee, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with FeedbackForOneself, PF-002.
- **Bo of Acme Logistics can't give feedback on Acme Trading's appraisal, judged before ratings that don't match.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's outsider, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with ReviewerNotInCompany, PF-003.
- **ratings missing a criteria are refused, even out of range.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria, PF-005.
- **and so are ratings naming a criteria twice.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria, PF-005.
- **and a criteria of Acme Logistics.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria, PF-005.
- **and every criteria with one more.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria, PF-005.
- **a rating over 1 is refused.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `101`, scale: 2 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingOutOfRange, PF-006.
- **and one below 0.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `-1`, scale: 2 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingOutOfRange, PF-006.
- **Dee rates Olga 0.2 and 1, in the other order: 0.7 and 1.5, a total of 2.2.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back [the last call's employeePerformanceFeedback, `2.2`] and gets back an answer matching `^epf_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Cy may give Olga a second feedback, 1 and 0.5: a total of 4.25.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back `4.25`.
- **and Cy gives feedback on it.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the last call's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Early thoughts.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `6`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `6`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back `3`.

|---|---|---|---|

|---|---|---|---|
| GoalCycleCompleted | 41 | GL-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| GoalIsGroup | 47 | GL-009 | declared in errors.ts |
| AppraisalAlreadyExists | 51 | AP-005 | another appraisal holds this employee and appraisal cycle; by the rule appraisal.oneAppraisalPerCycle |

- `GoalClosed`: carries goal (goal.id); emitted by the move close

- `GoalReopened`: carries goal (goal.id); emitted by the move reopen

- **and no longer move.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 2 id, progress { value: `100`, scale: 0 }, and is refused with GoalCycleCompleted, GL-001.

### set and track goals

Starts from the world `a started manual cycle`.

- **Cy can't move Olga's progress.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends goal the world's goal, progress { value: `50`, scale: 0 }, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Bo.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends goal the world's goal, progress { value: `50`, scale: 0 }, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Olga moves it to 50, and it is in progress.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the world's goal, progress { value: `50`, scale: 0 }, and gets back [the world's goal, `50`, the world's appraisal].
- **Platform's progress isn't set by hand.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 1 id, progress { value: `90`, scale: 0 }, and is refused with GoalIsGroup, GL-009.
- **even out of range, the group is judged first.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 1 id, progress { value: `150`, scale: 0 }, and is refused with GoalIsGroup, GL-009.

- **its progress still moves, to 100, and it stays closed.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the world's goal, progress { value: `100`, scale: 0 }, and is answered.
- **she may still move a goal she already has, to 70.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends goal the world's secondGoal, progress { value: `70`, scale: 0 }, and gets back [`70`, the world's secondAppraisal].
- **back to 0, it is pending.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, progress { value: `0`, scale: 0 }, and is answered.
- **at 99.99 it is still in progress.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, progress { value: `9999`, scale: 2 }, and is answered.
- **at 0.01 too.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, progress { value: `1`, scale: 2 }, and is answered.
- **but its progress moves back to 70, in progress.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 1 id, progress { value: `70`, scale: 0 }, and is answered.
- **and up to 100, completed.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, progress { value: `100`, scale: 0 }, and is answered.
- **it reaches 100 while archived.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, progress { value: `100`, scale: 0 }, and is answered.
- **it reaches 100 while closed.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, progress { value: `100`, scale: 0 }, and is answered.
- **no progress moves.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 5 id, progress { value: `70`, scale: 0 }, and is refused with GoalCycleCompleted, GL-001.
- **no group is judged before the cycle.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 1 id, progress { value: `70`, scale: 0 }, and is refused with GoalCycleCompleted, GL-001.

Starts from the world `a one-day list`.

- **its own weekday adds its one day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Monday`, and gets back [`1`, `1`].

### every weekday

Starts from the world `a leap fortnight`.

- **the weekday the list starts and ends on adds three, the leap day among them.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Tuesday`, and gets back [`3`, `3`].
- **the day after it adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Wednesday`, and gets back [`2`, `5`].
- **the third weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Thursday`, and gets back [`2`, `7`].
- **the fourth weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Friday`, and gets back [`2`, `9`].
- **the fifth weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Saturday`, and gets back [`2`, `11`].
- **the sixth weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Sunday`, and gets back [`2`, `13`].
- **the last weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Monday`, and gets back [`2`, `15`].

Starts from the world `a sunday holiday`.

| totalHolidays | HolidayCount |

## Move

`add`: from nothing (it creates) to active, emitting HolidayAdded.

## Steps

- `holiday.add.load` (database)
- `holiday.add.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| HolidayOutsideList | 42 | HD-002 | declared in errors.ts, carrying fromDate, toDate |
| HolidayDateTaken | 41 | HD-001 | another holiday holds this holiday list and holiday date; by the rule holiday.oneHolidayPerDay, carrying holidayDate |

## Worked examples

### a one-day list

Starts from the world `a one-day list`.

- **the day before its only day is outside it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-08-13`, description `Too early`, and is refused with HolidayOutsideList, HD-002, carrying fromDate `2028-08-14`, toDate `2028-08-14`.
- **so is the day after.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-08-15`, description `Too late`, and is refused with HolidayOutsideList, HD-002, carrying fromDate `2028-08-14`, toDate `2028-08-14`.
- **that day is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-08-14`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-08-14`.

### add holidays

Starts from the world `a holiday list`.

- **Ada adds the list's first day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-01-01`, description `New Year's Day`, and gets back [`1`] and gets back an answer matching `^hol_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **the same day can't be added twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-01-01`, description `Again`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2027-01-01`.
- **a day before the list starts is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2026-12-31`, description `Too early`, and is refused with HolidayOutsideList, HD-002, carrying fromDate `2027-01-01`, toDate `2027-12-31`.
- **so is a day after it ends.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-01-01`, description `Too late`, and is refused with HolidayOutsideList, HD-002, carrying fromDate `2027-01-01`, toDate `2027-12-31`.
- **Bo can't add a day to Ada's list.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-05-01`, description `Bo's day`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **the list's last day may be a holiday too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-12-31`, description `New Year's Eve`, and gets back [`2`].

### every weekday

Starts from the world `a leap fortnight`.

- **the leap day is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-02-29`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-02-29`.
- **the first of March is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-03-01`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-03-01`.
- **the second of March is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-03-02`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-03-02`.
- **the fourth of March is then taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2028-03-04`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2028-03-04`.

### weekly offs

Starts from the world `a sunday holiday`.

- **a day in the middle of the year is now taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-06-13`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2027-06-13`.
- **and so is the last one of the year.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-12-26`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2027-12-26`.
- **the first day is taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-01-01`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2027-01-01`.
- **and so is the last.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-12-31`, description `Picnic`, and is refused with HolidayDateTaken, HD-001, carrying holidayDate `2027-12-31`.
- **a day of another weekday may still be added.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, holidayDate `2027-01-04`, description `Picnic`, and gets back [`106`].

## How to call

```sh
capxul holiday add --holidayList <holidayList> --holidayDate <holidayDate> --description <description>
```

Give an interviewer's feedback on an interview: cleared or rejected.

**Who may call:** the self of its interviewer.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| interview | interview-feedback.interview |
| interviewer | interview-feedback.interviewer |
| result | interview-feedback.result |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| interviewFeedback | interview-feedback.id |

## Move

`give`: from nothing (it creates) to given, emitting InterviewFeedbackGiven.

## Steps

- `interview-feedback.give.load` (database)
- `interview-feedback.give.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| FeedbackGiverNotInterviewer | 41 | IF-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| FeedbackBeforeInterview | 42 | IF-002 | declared in errors.ts, carrying scheduledOn |
| FeedbackAlreadyGiven | 43 | IF-003 | another interview feedback holds this interview and interviewer; by the rule interview-feedback.oneFeedbackPerInterviewer |
| InterviewNotFound | 4 | IV-901 | nothing has the id in interview; the handler never runs; carries `id` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the self of its interviewer; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### give interview feedback

Starts from the world `an interview`.

- **Olga can't give feedback two days before the interview.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-03`.
- **Ada can't give it for her.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Bo.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Rejected`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bo can't give his own: he isn't one of its interviewers, which is judged before the day.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's outsider, result `Rejected`, and is refused with FeedbackGiverNotInterviewer, IF-001.
- **Olga still can't give it.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-03`.
- **nor can Cy.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Rejected`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-03`.
- **Bo still can't give his own.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's outsider, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackGiverNotInterviewer, IF-001.
- **Olga clears Pat, on the day itself.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and gets back an answer matching `^ifb_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Olga can't give a second, even another result.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Rejected`, and is refused with FeedbackAlreadyGiven, IF-003.
- **Olga can't give feedback on that one yet: its own day is judged.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-05`.
- **nor Cy.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-05`.
- **Cy can't give feedback on it: she isn't one of its interviewers.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackGiverNotInterviewer, IF-001.
- **Olga, who gave feedback on the technical interview, may still give it on the cleared final one.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Rejected`, and gets back an answer matching `^ifb_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Cy, who has left, still gives her feedback on the technical interview she was on, still pending.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Rejected`, and gets back an answer matching `^ifb_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Cy can't give a second.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackAlreadyGiven, IF-003.

### hire from a job opening

Starts from the world `a technical round`.

- **Olga clears Pat the same day.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and gets back an answer matching `^ifb_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul interview-feedback give --interview <interview> --interviewer <interviewer> --result <result>
```

Add a key result area to a company.

**Who may call:** the owner of its company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

| company | kra.company |

| field | value |

| kra | kra.id |

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to active, emitting KraCreated.

- `kra.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| KraTitleTaken | 41 | KR-001 | another kra holds this company and title; by the rule kra.oneTitlePerCompany, carrying title |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### set up kras and criteria

Starts from the world `three companies`.

- **Ada adds a KRA to Acme Trading.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Quality`, and gets back an answer matching `^kra_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **the same title can't be added to Acme Trading twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Quality`, and is refused with KraTitleTaken, KR-001, carrying title `Quality`.
- **but Acme Logistics may have its own.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, title `Quality`, and gets back an answer matching `^kra_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Bo can't add a KRA to Acme Trading.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Speed`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bo may use the title in Bo Ltd.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's boCompany, title `Quality`, and gets back an answer matching `^kra_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul kra create --company <company> --title <title>
```

HTTP: `POST /kra/create` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.kra.create(payload)`.

# shift-type.create

Add a working shift to a company, from its start time to its end time.

**Who may call:** the owner of its company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| company | shift-type.company |
| shiftTypeName | shift-type.shiftTypeName |
| startTime | shift-type.startTime |
| endTime | shift-type.endTime |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| shiftType | shift-type.id |

## Move

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to active, emitting ShiftTypeCreated.

## Steps

- `shift-type.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| ShiftStartsWhenItEnds | 42 | SH-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| ShiftTypeNameTaken | 41 | SH-001 | another shift type holds this company and shift type name; by the rule shift-type.oneNamePerCompany, carrying shiftTypeName |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### set up shift types

Starts from the world `three companies`.

- **Ada adds a day shift, nine to five.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `09:00`, endTime `17:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a night shift may end the morning after it starts.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Night`, startTime `22:00`, endTime `06:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a shift can't start when it ends.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Nothing`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `08:00`, and is refused with ShiftStartsWhenItEnds, SH-002.
- **nor at midnight, when it ends at midnight.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Midnight`, startTime `00:00`, endTime `00:00`, and is refused with ShiftStartsWhenItEnds, SH-002.
- **a name already taken, with the same start and end, is refused for its times first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `07:30`, endTime `07:30`, and is refused with ShiftStartsWhenItEnds, SH-002.
- **a shift one minute long is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Handover`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `08:01`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a shift exactly twelve hours long is allowed, eight in the morning to eight at night.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Twelve`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `20:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **an evening shift may end at midnight.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Evening`, startTime `16:00`, endTime `00:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a graveyard shift may start at midnight.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Graveyard`, startTime `00:00`, endTime `08:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a sixteen-hour shift is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Sixteen`, startTime `06:00`, endTime `22:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **and a fourteen-hour shift overnight.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Overnight`, startTime `18:00`, endTime `08:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a name in lower case is kept as typed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `late`, startTime `14:00`, endTime `22:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Day can't be added to Acme Trading twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `16:00`, and is refused with ShiftTypeNameTaken, SH-001, carrying shiftTypeName `Day`.
- **Bo can't add a shift to Ada's company.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Early`, startTime `06:00`, endTime `14:00`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Acme Logistics may have a Day shift of its own, with other times.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `16:30`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Bo adds a Day shift to Bo Ltd.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's boCompany, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `09:00`, endTime `17:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul shift-type create --company <company> --shiftTypeName <shiftTypeName> --startTime <startTime> --endTime <endTime>
```

HTTP: `POST /shift-type/create` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.shift-type.create(payload)`.
